user_run_diagnosis.zero_added_reason: Both searches overlapped. The first saved Group Underwriting Intern at Swiss Re; the second matched the same stable job ID and reported it as known. The added counter is persisted after screening completes.

changes.die_post_mobiliar_swissgrid: Bounded per-request retries for temporary HTTP and network failures; read-only catalog POSTs opt in explicitly.
changes.bkw_ruag: Host-level request pacing and two concurrent requests shared across overlapping search clients.
changes.m_s_software_engineering: The official Onlyfy feed can contain verified new jobs absent from the stale baked website snapshot. Country, identity, employer and total validation remain required.
changes.schindler_switzerland: An explicit visible closure notice with the same URL and vacancy title excludes the closed entry; generic missing markup remains an error.
changes.iwf: Preserves the HTTP status and official URL in diagnostics. Current catalog and prior vacancy page both return 404; this is not treated as a verified empty catalog.
changes.roche_centris: Added bounded per-request retries after fresh 502/timeout failures in the full check. Unit tests passed; live recheck could not be completed after network access failed.

verification.method: All 177 user-selected direct sources through create_vacancy_search_runner with runtime settings, in an isolated code copy. No AI screening or database writes in verification. Changes were copied into the working project after tests.
